controls.name: C-14d
controls.query:
FROM logs-system.auth-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= "2026-07-11T19:50:00.000Z" AND @timestamp < "2026-07-12T19:50:00.000Z"
  AND host.name == "web-2"
  AND event.outcome == "failure"
  AND process.name == "sshd"
  AND message LIKE "*Failed password*"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*)
